outcome: Give CPG teams a working Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO) capability on their own data — it reallocates trade spend to genuinely incremental promotions (TPO typically shows ROI within 60-90 days).
overview: Trade spend is one of the largest lines on a CPG profit and loss statement, and a substantial share of it funds promotions that were never incremental — some of it discounting volume the brand would have sold at full price anyway. Trade Promotion Optimization estimates lift, incrementality and cannibalisation by mechanic, retailer and SKU, so commercial teams can see which promotions genuinely pay back and argue the rest with evidence. It informs the spend decision; it never commits the money. Redington agrees a trade-spend ROI baseline first, then builds the models on the customer’s own POS, promotion, price and cost data over four to five weeks.
